description: Convert filament grams to metres (and back), compute volume and cost, and estimate how much is left on a spool from its gross weight. Knows densities for PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, Nylon, PC, CF blends. Give either `grams` or `meters`.

empty_spool_weight_grams.description: Weight of the empty spool (typ. 130–250 g).

grams.description: Filament weight. Give grams or meters, not both.

material.description: pla, petg, abs, asa, tpu, nylon, pc, pla-cf, petg-cf, pa-cf …

meters.description: Filament length. Give grams or meters, not both.

spool_gross_weight_grams.description: Weight of spool + remaining filament, to estimate what is left.

name: calculate_filament_usage
title: Filament weight ⇄ length ⇄ cost
